findings.title: PasswordHash exposure in GET /api/cms/portal-users
findings.evidence: requireAuth() instead of requireAdmin(); db.portalUser.findMany() returns full model including passwordHash
findings.boundary: CMS editor (lower trust) → reads all portal users' bcrypt hashes (higher sensitivity resource)
findings.fix: Change to requireAdmin(); add select: { passwordHash: false } to Prisma query

findings.title: CMS authorization bypass - 12 routes use requireAuth() instead of requireAdmin()
findings.evidence: grep shows requireAuth() in 12 route files; requireAuth() only validates JWT signature, not role='admin'
findings.boundary: CMS editor token → write/delete any CMS content, read bot config with API keys, list portal users with hashes
findings.fix: Replace all requireAuth() with requireAdmin() in /api/cms/** routes

findings.title: Prompt injection + DoS in public /api/chat/send
findings.evidence: messages array spread directly to LLM without filtering role; no rate limit/CAPTCHA/Guardian on paid LLM endpoint
findings.boundary: Anonymous attacker → injects system messages to override prompt, exhausts LLM quota
findings.fix: Filter messages to only role:'user'; add rate limit + CAPTCHA + Guardian; sanitize knowledgeContext

findings.title: Stored XSS via NewsArticle.content in HomeSection ReactMarkdown
findings.evidence: <ReactMarkdown>{selectedNews.content}</ReactMarkdown> with no sanitization; CMS accepts HTML in content field
findings.boundary: CMS admin (trusted but compromised) → stores → executes in every visitor's browser
findings.fix: Add rehype-sanitize plugin to ReactMarkdown or pre-sanitize with sanitizeHtml()

findings.title: CSP in production without real nonce or strict-dynamic
findings.evidence: Middleware generates nonce in x-rmc-nonce header but CSP script-src uses 'unsafe-inline' without nonce; strict-dynamic absent
findings.boundary: Any XSS (like H-001) executes despite CSP; no defense-in-depth
findings.fix: Inject nonce into script-src directive; enable strict-dynamic; deploy report-only first

findings.title: serverActions.allowedOrigins missing (documented regression)
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md documents this fix but next.config.ts lacks serverActions.allowedOrigins key
findings.boundary: Attacker tricks victim into POST to Server Action from malicious origin → CSRF on Server Actions
findings.fix: Add serverActions: { allowedOrigins: ['https://registro-mercantil.xetid.cu', ...] }

findings.title: poweredByHeader not disabled (documented regression)
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md documents poweredByHeader: false but next.config.ts lacks it; default true leaks Next.js version
findings.boundary: Passive fingerprinting → targeted exploits for known version vulnerabilities
findings.fix: Add poweredByHeader: false

findings.title: User enumeration in /api/portal/auth/login
findings.evidence: Returns 'Usuario no encontrado' vs 'Contraseña incorrecta' — different messages reveal account existence
findings.boundary: Anonymous attacker → enumerates registered portal users (registradores)
findings.fix: Unify to generic 'Credenciales inválidas' (matching CMS login behavior)

findings.title: JWT type confusion - requireAuth() doesn't validate payload.type
findings.evidence: JWTPayload has type?: 'portal'|'cms'; requireAuth() accepts any valid token regardless of type
findings.boundary: Portal user token (type:portal) accepted in CMS routes (and vice versa); lateral privilege escalation
findings.fix: requireAuth() validates type === 'cms'; create requirePortalAuth() for type === 'portal'

findings.title: Portal login missing CAPTCHA and Guardian (vs CMS login)
findings.evidence: CMS login has rate limit + CAPTCHA v2 + Guardian; portal login only has rate limit; AGENTS.md claims both have it
findings.boundary: Brute force on portal credentials easier than CMS; no behavioral analysis
findings.fix: Reuse CAPTCHA + Guardian logic in portal login route

findings.title: IDOR + Mass Assignment in /api/cms/faqs/[id] PUT/DELETE
findings.evidence: requireAuth() not requireAdmin(); db.fAQ.update({ data: body }) accepts any field from body
findings.boundary: Editor token → modifies/deletes any FAQ by ID; injects arbitrary fields (visible, order, etc.)
findings.fix: requireAdmin() + validate body with CMS_SCHEMAS['faqs'].update

findings.title: Bot config editable by non-admin (prompt injection persistent + API key leak)
findings.evidence: GET/POST use requireAuth(); editor can read/modify systemPrompt, apiKey, apiUrl, model
findings.boundary: Editor → persistent prompt injection affecting all chat users; extracts LLM API keys
findings.fix: Change to requireAdmin()

findings.title: AuthZ errors masked as 500 in cms-handler
findings.evidence: requireAdmin() throws 'Unauthorized'/'Forbidden' caught by generic handler returning 500
findings.boundary: SIEM/logs cannot distinguish auth failures from server errors; attack detection impaired
findings.fix: Catch specific error messages and return 401/403 status codes

findings.title: origin-check ALLOWED_ORIGINS computed at module init (static)
findings.evidence: const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = getAllowedOrigins() evaluated once; runtime env changes not reflected
findings.boundary: Low practical risk (env immutable in deploy), but violates least-surprise; stale allowlist possible in long-running containers
findings.fix: Move getAllowedOrigins() call inside checkOrigin() or use cached getter with invalidation

findings.title: TypeScript ignoreBuildErrors allows unsafe code to production
findings.evidence: typescript: { ignoreBuildErrors: true } — build passes with type errors
findings.boundary: Type errors in validation/auth logic could reach production undetected
findings.fix: Set to false; fix genuine type errors; use // @ts-expect-error for false positives

findings.title: dangerouslyAllowSVG not explicitly set to false
findings.evidence: images config lacks dangerouslyAllowSVG; default false in Next 16 but not explicit
findings.fix: Add dangerouslyAllowSVG: false to images config

findings.title: images.remotePatterns not configured (default 'self' is safe)
findings.evidence: No remotePatterns key; Next defaults to 'self' only — safe but not explicit
findings.fix: Configure explicit allowlist if external images needed; otherwise document intentional default

findings.title: Middleware matcher excludes /api/* — static CSP fallback applies
findings.evidence: matcher excludes api/, _next/static, etc.; these routes get static CSP with 'unsafe-inline'
findings.fix: Acceptable (API returns JSON), but document rationale

findings.title: Server-generated CAPTCHA SVG rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML (trusted)
findings.location: Multiple files (reset-password, AccesoSection, ConsultasSection, ContactForm, ForgotPasswordSection)
findings.evidence: captchaSvg generated server-side with no user input; rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML
findings.fix: No action needed — server-generated, not user-controlled

findings.title: Chatbot LLM responses properly sanitized before render
findings.evidence: sanitizeLine() and sanitizeHtml() (DOMPurify) applied to all LLM output before dangerouslySetInnerHTML
findings.fix: Correct implementation — no action needed

findings.title: File upload validation robust (magic bytes, path traversal, extension allowlist)
findings.evidence: verifyMagicBytes, path normalization, ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS allowlist, requireAdmin on serve
findings.fix: Correct implementation — no action needed

findings.title: Origin check uses closed allowlist, rejects missing Origin
findings.evidence: ALLOWED_ORIGINS built from NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, PORTAL_DOMAINS, localhost ports; checkOrigin returns false if no Origin header
findings.fix: Correct implementation — no action needed

findings.title: Critical dependencies patched (next 16.4.3, next-auth 4.24.15, sharp 0.35.5)
findings.evidence: Ranges satisfy minimum versions for CVE-2026-96889, GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr, GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36, GHSA-7rqj-j65f-68wh, CVE-2026-94545
findings.fix: Verify lockfile resolves to patched versions; monitor for new CVEs

needs_validation.blocker: No access to Traefik/Caddy config to verify header overwrite
